origin_meaning: ground point midway between the two soles of the approved stance (near sole is 13 px lower = closer to camera)
scale_note: 1 px = 1 native art px (approved 160 px Kai scale); game currently shows Kai ~79 px tall (setScale ~0.49)

root_motion.contract: frames are in place; Phaser owns movement, collision, hitboxes and damage; events are frame indices only

Run.speed_note: in-place cycle, 3.5 steps/s at 14 fps; scale fps with speed (14*speed/250, clamp 10..18). Front-view stance feet cannot lock to the world at 250 px/s.

BasicPunch.hit_contract: apply damage/hitstop in Phaser on 'impact' (0-based frame 5)
